field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal prefix; success: kv260_latency_transcript_captured OR complete:/blocked_kv260_ssh_unreachable (an honest non-terminal continuity record).
field_principles.inference_substrate: hardware_smoke -- an SSH-attached board test; the duration floor is per-board, not the 60s live-model floor.
field_principles.kv260_latency_numbers: the on-board per-sample Ising latency transcript (the terminal-state deliverable) -- present only if reachable; null + blocked verdict otherwise.
field_principles.kv260_ssh_reachable: the SSH-reachability result (the CORRECT precondition; NEVER host SD-card device nodes).
field_principles.kv260_synthesis_succeeded: true if the carnot Ising overlay loaded + ran on-board -- part of the terminal-state definition (north-star §3).
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records the SSH-reachability check (NEVER host SD-card); pre-empts the wrong-mechanism SD-card confusion + missing-resource fabrication.
field_principles.random_seed: determinism precondition for reproducibility (the sampler seed).
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content-addressed hash of the bitstream + transcript inputs.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: false -- a hardware latency measurement invokes no verifier oracle.
